mgmt_bio.text: Alex Norstrom serves as co-CEO of Spotify alongside Gustav Soderstrom, the pair having taken the helm after co-founder Daniel Ek moved from CEO to Chairman at the end of 2025. Norstrom brings business and commercial expertise to the partnership, complementing Soderstrom's product and technology background, and both have worked closely with Ek for more than a decade. Under this leadership, capital allocation priorities center on reinvesting in the business for future growth, mostly through internal R&D but also acquisitions, alongside returning excess capital via opportunistic share repurchases.

sentences.quote: Founder and Chief Executive Officer Daniel Ek will transition to the role of Executive Chairman effective January 1, 2026.
sentences.text: Alex Norstrom and Gustav Soderstrom became co-CEOs on 1 January 2026, succeeding founder Daniel Ek, who moved to executive chairman, a European-style setup in which he determines capital allocation and maps the company's long-term future; both report to Ek and sit on the board subject to shareholder approval.

In March 2026 Spotify said John Giraldo, Global Controller at NBCUniversal, would become Chief Accounting Officer from 26 May 2026, succeeding Mr. Sawyer, whose departure did not stem from any accounting disagreement.

The co-CEOs framed the change as a continuation of Spotify's journey rather than a fresh start, and segment reporting was realigned from 1 January 2026 to reflect them as joint chief operating decision makers.
